overview.description: The State Street Short Duration IG Public & Private Credit ETF (PRSD) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is designed to provide diversified, actively managed exposure to investment-grade USD denominated, public and private credit. The average portfolio duration is expected to be between 1-3 years PRSD was launched on Sep 9, 2025 and is issued by State Street.
